title: fix(mcp): escape terminal controls in registry reports
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes MCP registry reports, mutation acknowledgements, and errors that emit terminal controls from saved server names, launch details, or diagnostics.

## User Impact

Human-readable report fields preserve printable Unicode and visibly escape controls. Stored definitions, JSON envelopes, and current credential-redaction behavior remain unchanged.

## Why This Change Was Made

A single command-local `logMcpLine` applies the canonical `sanitizeTerminalText` to human report lines; the human error path uses the same sanitizer. JSON and protocol output bypass it. The integration preserves the newer credential-redaction fix in list/show.

Thanks @Alix-007 for the fix, regression tests, and original real-CLI proof.

## Evidence

- Both registered-command regressions fail on unchanged main production code (2 failed, 33 skipped; 19.50s runner duration, 153.09s command wall time including preparation): list output and mutation acknowledgement contain raw controls.
- All 35 owner tests pass with the fix (99.00s runner duration, 199.27s command wall time), including terminal/JSON/storage assertions, credential redaction, and the existing initialize/probe timeout case. This successful run does not claim a repair to the previously reported local transport failure; transport code is unchanged.
- Targeted typed oxlint, oxfmt, and `git diff --check` pass. Independent Codex review through P2 is scoped-clean. After integrating current main, all 35 owner tests pass again (44.42s runner duration, 108.70s command wall time), with typed lint, formatting, and diff checks passing. The owner and test files match the independently reviewed candidate byte-for-byte.
- Against main: production +40/−38 (net +2), tests +30/−0, docs +1/−0. One human-line output owner replaces repeated raw logging calls; no new policy or transport behavior.
- A fresh standalone CLI live replay was not repeated on this source-only, heavily loaded Mac. Inspected prior contributor built Linux CLI traces show list/status/show-header/static-doctor controls changing from 1/2/1/1 to 0/0/0/0 with raw JSON and configuration bytes preserved. That evidence predates the current integration; it is not an exact-head live claim. The current owner suite exercises local stdio probing; external transports and delegated OAuth login were not live-tested.
